title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Science and Public Discussion
prompt: In many countries, scientists are encouraged to communicate their research directly to the public through social media, public lectures, and open debates. Some people believe this openness strengthens trust in science and improves decision-making, while others worry that simplified messages and hostile online discussions can distort findings and undermine scientific authority. Discuss both views and give your own opinion on whether scientists should engage in informal public discussion of their work. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确要求讨论双方观点并给出自己的立场。建议用5分钟规划：引言段引出话题并表明立场；主体段一论述科学家直接与公众交流的好处（如提升信任、促进知情决策）；主体段二论述风险（如信息简化、网络敌意讨论扭曲研究）；最后一段总结并重申个人观点。注意使用学术写作风格，避免口语化表达，确保段落清晰、论证充分。写完后检查是否达到250词以上，并核对是否回应了题目所有要求。
